title: Range sum with point updates
statement: Process queries on an array: [0, i, v] sets nums[i] = v; [1, l, r] asks for nums[l] + … + nums[r]. Return the answers to the sum queries in order. Up to 2 × 10⁴ of each.
hints: Prefix sums make queries O(1) but updates O(n); a plain array is the reverse.
A Fenwick (binary indexed) tree makes both O(log n).

solution.explanation: The trade-off triangle: prefix sums (O(1) query, O(n) update) vs raw array (O(1) update, O(n) query). A Fenwick tree stores partial sums over ranges whose lengths are powers of two, defined by the lowest set bit: i += i & -i walks up for updates, i -= i & -i walks down for prefix queries. Both O(log n), about 15 lines of code. An update is a delta: store the current array to compute it.
